papers.title: Re-TACRED: Addressing Shortcomings of the TACRED Dataset
papers.identity_evidence: PDFp1 title and authors George Stoica, Emmanouil Antonios Platanios, Barnabas Poczos; footer arXiv2104.08398v1 16Apr2021. Versioned preprint, not publisher-version certification.
findings: Pp1-3 define sentence with ordered subject/object spans and entity types; supplied type mistakes can exclude correct annotation candidates. The reported roughly5% type-error finding concerns a sampled original TACRED audit, not a measured remaining error rate of our cohort.

P4 PERSON:IDENTITY expands alternate names to pronominal coreference. Arbitrary independent name replacement preserving types need not preserve this semantic relation. Merged organization labels and ambiguity guidelines also limit universal invariance assumptions.
P5 Re-TACREDv1.1 has91467examples and40relations. Matching project counts alone does not establish byte identity.
limitations: Only pp1-5 read and p4 rendered; later experiments/appendices not certified.
No proof of universal name invariance or current type correctness; source-patch audit is recorded separately.

papers.title: Should We Rely on Entity Mentions for Relation Extraction? Debiasing Relation Extraction with Counterfactual Analysis
papers.identity_evidence: PDFp1 exact title and authors Yiwei Wang et al.; footer arXiv2205.03784v1 8May2022. Author list read on original title page.
findings: Pp1-4 distinguish useful entity information from name bias; source causal graph is a modeling proposal, not an identified structural truth for our head.
P5eq2 inference subtraction Y_final=Y_x-lambda1*Y_maskedcontext_entity-lambda2*Y_fullymasked; raw-input interventions rerun contextual encoding. Training remains unchanged.
P5eq3 selects lambda coefficients on validation and freezes them on test; type-based label filtering can be used when type information is available. None of those operations was executed here.
limitations: Only pp1-5 read/p5 rendered; experiments, code and pp6-11 not audited or reproduced.
Generic counterfactual entity debiasing already has direct prior art. Masked-input rerunning is not equivalent to masking head positions after full encoding.

papers.title: A Variational Approach for Mitigating Entity Bias in Relation Extraction
papers.identity_evidence: PDFp1 exact title and authors Samuel Mensah, Elena Kochkina, Jabez Magomere, Joy Prakash Sain, Simerjot Kaur, Charese Smiley; footer arXiv2506.11381v1 13Jun2025.
findings: P2 bounds conditional I(X;Z|E) by an expected conditional Gaussian KL term. Conditional mutual information alone does not assert I(E;Z)=0; this is not a refutation of the actual KL training objective.
P3eq5 blends sampled entity representations with input embeddings before PLM: x_prime=x*(1-M)+x*M*(1-beta)+z*M*beta. Entity-marker hidden states then feed the classifier; CE+alpha*VIB is optimized.
P4 reports3-run microF1 on TACRED, REFinD and BioRED ID/OOD cases; no transfer to Q-RMEA Macro or our fixed cohort has been demonstrated.
limitations: Only pp1-4 read/p2,p3 rendered; pp5-9 and code not audited. Exact gradient behavior of alpha or semantic interpretation of learned variance not certified.
Not evidence that all entity information is nuisance or that existing contextual features can implement input-level interventions.
